notificationEditor.title: Notification policy
notificationEditor.boundary: Edit delivery policy and security digest templates. Saving does not test the trigger or send a notification. Credentials, destinations and execution settings remain read-only.
notificationEditor.providerForced: This provider controls this value. It cannot be edited here.
notificationEditor.triggerUnavailable: This exact notification trigger is not available in the editor snapshot.
notificationEditor.apiUnavailable: This server does not provide the notification policy editor API.
notificationEditor.templateHelp: Removing a template restores the built-in defaults when rendering. Templates cannot be empty. Editing a template does not change the security delivery mode.
notificationEditor.templateUnavailable: This server does not provide this template field.
notificationEditor.templateEmpty: Templates cannot be empty. Enter text or explicitly remove the file value.
notificationEditor.providerUnsupported: This provider does not support security digest templates.
notificationEditor.interpolationHelp: Whole values such as {reference} or {fallback} use YAML environment interpolation and become read-only after reload. Scan expressions such as {expression} remain editable. Do not put secrets in templates.
